notes.title: Weekly News #36 - Mobile Version Updates
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/bee0ba5db0480f29504752c30c7e9be5b6b12fac.jpg[/img]

Hi All!

We announce that Second Second's mobile version is updated so you can play all modes like campaign, training, and PvP which works together with PC's.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Huuuuge optimization works are done. So we hope any loading or latency would be decreased a lot.
[*] PC's big re-work updates are applied in the mobile version.
[*] All modes like campaign, training, PvP mode is now available on the mobile version.
[/list]

[h1]Notice[/h1]
As you already know, when you purchase the Steam version, we give you the full version of Mobile.
But the way to activating full version has changed as follows:

1. Create an account in steam version PvP mode.
2. In the mobile version PvP mode, sign in with the above account.
3. The full version of the mobile version will be unlocked.

We hope new users get the free full mobile version without any inconvenience.
See you in the mobile version! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Weekly News #33 - PvP Ghost
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/6452164c6222fc41c813242668d55d2a18e6d6a0.jpg[/img]

Hello!
We keep updating PvP mode which is newly added last week.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/9ce7649929235a9243a47cc58bfcef685a39d4be.gif[/img]

[h1]Now we have added the 'Ghost mode'.[/h1]
When you enter the game, your deck will be uploaded to a server and a ghost AI will be made.

A ghost AI will meet other online players. When a player's ghost wins other online players, your MMR will be increased and the opponent's MMR will be decreased.
But when your ghost is defeated, the opponent's MMR will be increased but your MMR is not decreased.

We hope this system makes Second Second's PvP more active and interesting.

See you next week!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Weekly News #25 - Bug Fixes and Updates
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/b7bf737b186f9cd5e7a56f82c8d3e213445dac82.jpg[/img]

We uploaded the new version and are applying the bugs and opinions we've been told through community hub.  
The followings are the fixed bugs and applied contents in this week.


[h1][b]<System>[/b][/h1]
- 'Continue' button is available 
- Fixed an issue that game paused when the deck edit button is pressed.

[h1][b]<Battle>[/b][/h1]
- Fixed an issue that enemy is healed when player takes damage in lifesteal damage state.
- Fixed an issue that Rampage of 'Lose Oneself' changes other cards' positions 
- Fixed an issue that 'Corrupted Slash' gives Weak state instead of giving Weak token.
- Fixed an issue that 'Reboot' removes Stealth cards.
- Fixed an issue that 'Codestruction' gives Phasing not in 'cast state' but 'activation state'.
- Fixed an issue that transparent waiting cards are applied to other states instead of Strong and Weak state.


[h1][b]<Event>[/b][/h1]
- Fixed an issue that 'Radioactive Area' doesn't show the result when player paid a card.

[h1][b]<Visuals>[/b][/h1]
- The effect of the Wild card is modified because it made it difficult to identify whether the card is selected or not when opening the card pack.

We keep checking and applying your opinions and bug reports on the new version. We update every week or several times a day so please stay tuned to our works. Thank you! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Weekly News #16 - Update Delay Notice
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/542f6f8f13ca758ab339046947a616d3709fe315.jpg[/img]

Hello, We are sorry to let you know that there's a delay in the update schedule.ːsteamsadː

One reason why the update has been postponed is that the balancing of the cards has not yet reached a satisfactory level. We made more changes than we had in the process of intuitively changing card's powers and designing new interactions. So it took more time than we've expected, and new cards' balance has not been fully examined.

 We are planning for great balance that can be used for Second Second PVP mode as well. Since Second Second has no randomness factors in battle, we thought that bad card balance is the worst thing that can happen in our game. Also, this decision was made because the release date we desire of PVP mode is not that far from now.

We will upload new works through the test client as soon as it completes. We are so grateful to all those who are waiting and sorry again about the postponement.

notes.title: Weekly News #13 - Working On: Card Archetypes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/49172c54a2dc614f3f4f5995a7ffc2705d12fdf9.jpg[/img]

Greetings! This week we have outlined 27 archetypes that determine the characters and abilities of a deck. These archetypes will determine which cards appear when a 'wild card' is opened.
  In addition, Second Second's monsters will have new card presets which take charge of one of the following archetypes.
 

[h1][b]<Damage>[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/2a581be18748d2969e512f5a5c0f790aac330ca1.jpg[/img]

Damage cards are the essential cards of the game and will be the same as the existing classification.


[h1][b]<Assist>[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/f832f4d4303ebbe23d99dfba5da1f89b73fb5889.jpg[/img]

These cards assist in combat, such as neutralizing an opponent's damage card or offsetting the damage.


[h1][b]<Utility>[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/50b02c022772ec7b2e68bb000c596ceb258750fe.jpg[/img]

Utility cards directly help combat.
[list]
[*] 'Time Advantage' cards become stronger when a player's turn gets longer.
[*] 'My turn bonus' cards become strong when they are cast using as much of player's turn or activated on player's turn.
[*] 'Silence' cards prevent the opponent from using cards within a certain category on a turn basis.
[*] 'Double damage' cards increase damage within a certain amount of time.
[/list] 

[h1][b]<State>[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/f658523bfd90a45618cc4f083ef072847174e3b1.jpg[/img]

'State' cards increase the potential of player's cards or disturb the opponent's cards. This is the same as the existing state system.


[h1][b]<Special>[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/09bd48d8010a0dca309fe44fbae3ea915117347c.jpg[/img]

'Special' cards make it possible to counter advantageous weapon types. For example, 'Cannon'(Yellow) cards have a long cast time, so there is a high risk of cancellation by 'Gun'(Blue) cards. But 'Stealth' cannon cards make it possible to attack without risk.

notes.title: Weekly News #12 - Working On: New Keywords
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/c201000ad114f132749dd5f477d08d2b88fa247e.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone! A lot of updates are in progress and new tasks are systematically needed. That is why our patches are getting late.ːsteamsadː

 We will rearrange contents such as cards and UI etc. Also, we will attend Taipei Game Show (TGS 2019) at the end of January. So we plan to update new contents before the lunar holidays. In the meantime, We will share what we're working on weekly.

Today, we are going to briefly introduce some new tags to be added to the Second Second.

[h1][b]<Will>[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/35c44b9969bdba9b8c341b8945c0aca8392da207.jpg[/img]
'Will' tag replaces previous 'Ignore Lock'. Cards with 'Will' tag don't move behind the slot after using it and can be used repeatedly.

[h1][b]<Unstable>[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/38a179114f8b4f61d405fefed5d161fcc6d57989.jpg[/img]
Cards with 'Unstable' tag are canceled if player's HP is reduced while casting.

[h1][b]<Collect>[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/cca9e9385977e17dd1d5bf452b21f25f8e1bdd16.jpg[/img]
Cards with the 'Collect' tag can bring back the applied states(Strong, Weak etc.) to usable 'tokens' after they are activated.


We've been discussing and making things which can upgrade several inconvenient issues maintaining Second Second's own unique system.
Hope you guys like upcoming big updates. Happy new year!

You will be able to store 6 states(Strong, Weak etc) as resources and use them when you want.
You receive a penalty when you don't spend negative state resources.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/a46d888969a80895e474a58d0c93090b31282130.gif[/img]

We are in the process of improving the card notation. Those who are accustomed to the Second Second can read the card quickly through the abbreviated version. But if you are not familiar with the short version, you can expand the contents part to read details about the card in the next update.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/ee000564f964e75ce9933519f621efb41e12b52f.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Division of cast and activation function[/b]: For better understanding the card's detail, we plan to apply a method to distinguish the card's cast function(upper part of the expanded version) and activation function(lower part of the expanded version).
[*][b]Making conditional functions easier to recognize [/b]: We plan to apply a method that makes conditional functions(lines which need HP or Stack points to be applied) to be seen clearly 
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/5055d24a081b081d39f6fe7d7ce8db442b8f1b3a.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Classification of 'pay something to use' functions[/b]: We plan to apply a method of showing functions that use resources such as HP or Stack seem more distinctive.
[/list]

[h1]<Status system change notice>[/h1]
We plan to change the status system(Charge, Waste, Haste etc.). Players can collect status and choose to use it when they need or keep it for later. In the case of negative states(Waste, Slow, Weak), penalties occur when they are not used in player's turn.

[h1]<Simplifying cards & Card's power improvement notice>[/h1]
We plan to make it more comprehensible to identify terms and card's abilities.
In addition, we will upgrade cards that are not used often because of poor combo potential or poor performance.

[h1]<Bug Fixes>[/h1]
- Now Steam achievement synchronization is done once every time the game is turned on.
- Now some 'ignoring status' cards are applied to status when they're cast.
Fixed the issue of status(Charge, Waste etc.) not disappearing when 'instant' cards are cast.
- The 'Crossed: Echo' effect on the 'Flare' card works properly.
- Fixed a bug that caused the opponent to cast a card when using 'Memory: DOS' to cancel the casting card and make the opponent's remaining time to 0 seconds.
- Fixed the problem that cards remain on the screen when touching or clicking the card when moving to the next sector.

- Fixed the crushing phenomenon that occurred in the mobile version.

notes.title: Weekly News #2 - Training Mode, Standard Mode Difficulties!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/ec5fa1d5b2507c14384716ab159627c68cdcabc3.jpg[/img]

It has been a truly long week for our team after the release of Second Second. A big portion of what we did was reading all the comments reviews, watching streamers playing the Second Second. It has been a precious chance to see and understand how what we designed is received by gamers outside of our team and also a great opportunity to map our next direction. Also, we worked on some huge updates as follows:) :

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/67a3e9b1076dddb2c72515ec2918c516f2227372.gif[/img]
[h1]<Training Mode>[/h1]
[b]-Added Training Mode including 37 puzzles with detailed explanations of the keywords and symbols, 1 new background, new skins for 3 enemy models[/b]
Comment: There has been a lot of feedback on the lack of explanation on various elements that are most important in combat. Now in Training Mode, we made a series of puzzles where players can learn all the keywords and symbols, and even how to deal with complex combat situation by using pre-picked cards and enemies stage by stage. Even for the experienced players out there, playing this mode would be a delightful experience.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33696863/1a017e770f7db5fa086abc2309137e64dc0c32e7.gif[/img]
[h1]<Standard Mode AI Difficulties>[/h1]
[b]-Added AI difficulty selection in Standard Mode and difficulty achievements[/b]
Comment: We intended to make Standard Mode would provide a whole new different experience compare to Campaign Mode. However, lots of people told us about the frustrative difficulty of this mode and we decided to let the players choose the brainpower of the AI. There are 10 levels and you can choose to start from either level 1 or any other levels you want. Once you finish a level, the levels below will be automatically marked as completed.

[h1]<Bug Fixes>[/h1]
-Fixed a problem that occurred when cards with additional effects, such as Disperse, were fired on your opponent's turn.
- Fixed a problem where the basic card used by AI when you entered 'Continue' from the main menu was not saved properly.
- Fixed a problem where the tooltip that appears when you mouse over a card in deck editing is not displayed properly due to the screen border or other card. Now they will be displayed in different location.
- (English version only) Fixed an issue on the results of the 'Landslide' event.

[h1]<Improvements>[/h1]
-Now you can change graphics quality in Settings
-Added animation effects for icons that appear on timeline. Common effects/effects that can't be cancelled/instant effects are now distinguishable on timeline.
-Now the description pop-ups you can see when you mouseover a keyword shows differently when the keyword is a condition and when it's an effect.
-The layout of the UI that pops up when the mouse is over the card has been improved.
-A visual effect for 'Poison' effect has been added
-Illustrations of the following cards have been added: Taunt, Valor Charm, Check, Fair and Square, Vampirize

notes.title: Weekly News #1 - Available on Steam Early Access!
notes.content:

-Events that are linked to other events

-Events that is related to the time spent in one sector
-Events that is related to day/night system

-Making systems for collecting, analyzing user play records(will be disclosed)
(this month and beyond)
-Stories to be revealed for Standard presets that is connected to Campaigns.

[b]*In the future[/b]

-Cards' gimmicks can be added based on user's preferences

We will be posting every week with exciting news on Second Second. Stay tuned!

notes.content:

Hello, everyone! ːsteamhappyː
Thanks to the support of many people, we are doing our best to prepare the Early Access version of Second Second.

[h1]Early Access Release in October 16th[/h1]
Second Second is available from October 16th. We will have a 10% discount period immediately after launch for a while. You can receive notifications immediately after launch by registering on your Wishlist.

Second Second have unique rules without card-drawing. Before the release, we will upload a short play-through video so that you can see the rules and see the features of the game at a glance.
